text:
anya: Heads up — we need a decision on how Dedicated should handle burst traffic for the upcoming pilot customers. I sketched a compact proposal below; product + eng + SRE input needed by EOD Fri.

mike: Quick TL;DR?

anya: TL;DR: aim for predictable fairness + graceful degradation. Propose a 'soft-spill' burst mode that: 1) allows short bursts above reservation, 2) enforces per-tenant smoothing to avoid long tails, 3) has carryover credits for small overages, and 4) clear rollout gates + observability.

jules: SRE constraints: we can't allow noisy tenants to push latency SLOs across the pool. We need an emergency preempt path and clear metrics to trigger it. Also want a maximum spill duration, e.g., 10 minutes, after which preemption starts. :warning:

pat: From CS — customers care about two things: "can I burst when I need to" and "how will I be billed/credited". Pilot customers asked for at least 20% burst headroom. We'll need a customer-facing doc and an opt-in handshake.

sara: Data note: sampled last 90 days from our largest pools — 95th percentile burst above reservation lasted <6 minutes 82% of the time, but top 3 tenants caused extended tail events. I can share a per-tenant histogram tomorrow.

anya: Here's a compact config example to discuss (informal):

```yaml
burst_policy:
  mode: soft_spill           # allow temporary over-reservation
  headroom_percent: 15      # default headroom for pilot tenants
  carryover_days: 7         # small credits roll over for 7 days
  max_spill_minutes: 10     # hard cap before preemption
  smoothing_window_sec: 60  # smoothing for short spikes
  billing_mode: credit_based # credits consumed for spill
```

mike: Questions from eng: how do KV-cache and batching interact with spill? If we evict aggressively during preempt, tail latency could spike. We should test with a preemption pattern that reuses cached prefixes. Also need a perf budget estimate for pre-warming ~5% capacity.

jules: Agree on perf tests. Also ask that the preempt strategy be two-stage: 1) soft-throttle (request queuing/backpressure), 2) tenant preempt based on credits + SLA. Soft-throttle avoids cache churn.

pat: For pilot onboarding: propose a 3-step checklist: 1) customer signs opt-in terms (burst headroom + billing model), 2) product triage call + traffic profile, 3) staged enable (10% of traffic -> 50% -> 100%) with rollback gates.

anya: Proposed launch gates for MVP:
- Observability: per-tenant burst metrics, 95/99 latency, preemption events, credit burn rate
- Reliability: automated rollback if pool-wide 99th token latency increases >X%
- Cost guardrail: pre-warm budget limit (configurable per pool)
- Docs & CS playbook: onboarding doc + billing FAQ + incident playbook

mike: Implementation notes: will add a feature flag + canary rollout (pool-level). Need estimated eng work: ~3 sprints for core policy, 1 sprint for billing hooks, 1 sprint for console/metrics. Could parallelize SRE telemetry.

sara: I can produce the pilot traffic report and a recommended default headroom by Wed.

jules: Will prepare a chaos test matrix (simulate tenants hitting carryover then preempt) and add alarms for when smoothing isn't enough.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary window scheduled for feature-flag rollout once PR is merged. :robot_face:

anya: Action items: @mike create RFC PR with the above config by Tue; @sara attach pilot telemetry; @jules draft SRE test plan; @pat draft CS opt-in template. I'll own launch gates doc and timeline.

mike: Ack. I'll try to get the RFC up tomorrow.

pat: We'll prep the customer template and run a dry-run with 1 pilot next week.

anya: Thanks all — sync tomorrow 10am to finalize numbers. :thumbsup:
